Absolutely attrocious!!! Cannot understand how come a big company like Sun Life can develop & promote such an app: ugly interface, messy, full of advertisements, one can turn around for minutes trying to find basic functionalities, only to realize they are not implemented. I'm trying to remain civil, but I could find better words to describe it ... The one star is only because I cannot give it a zero.

My first day using. It works quickly. I'm not happy with the way we are required to fill out out our birthdate info: we have swipe back individual calendar months. As an adult, I had to swipe back 100s of times, then it didn't stay entered. I never did get to finish to get the info I needed so had to call and speak to a representative. I had to call separate from the app because its call feature wasn't working either 😕 The human being I spoke with, Jacques, answered all my questions.

Sign-in is horrible... It won't remember passwords and everytime you click remember me it clears email and password. Then when you finally enter all info, you have to enter a code, but tell it how you want to receive the code, because it won't remember that either. You want people to use the app, but you make the sign in process 10x more difficult than my banking!

Garbage app.always makes you make a new password. If you don't use this app pretty much once or twice a week then it automatically makes you change your password for not logging in for so long. For most people you have a few passwords off the top of your head. Why would the fact that I didn't log into the app make me change my password? It doesn't make any sense. Every time I try to use this app I always have to change the password and it takes me 10-15 minutes just to get in. Fix that please.

They keep promoting the app but the app only display basic info and does not have some of the features found on the website. Basically you are stuck doing a combination of app+website to get anything. Customers service staff is clueless and gives random information that is usually not correct or they simply just tell you they don't know. Anyways what can I do, i can't switch since it with employer.

So far, not a great experience. I've been trying for several days to get a form I need to submit to my doctor for approval on a subscription I've been taking for a year. I keep running into a road block always being told I need a upgrade to adobe reader. It is installed but I still haven't been able to open the form. Extremely frustrating! Unacceptable!

Very convenient for checking and submit documents. If the sign in can be improved, I would give higher rate. Currently sign in, after name entered, when I want move to "password" field, the entered name get cleared. I have to enter again. It is annoying.

The app doesn't remember verified devices, so you have to do useless 2-factor authentication every time you log in. It is convenient that I just need to tilt my phone to access the insurance card, but having that work off the home screen has me paranoid that someone will accidentally tip the phone back and suddenly see more of my medical and financial details than I have consented to share.

Having to get a text verification code is inane. Youre sending me a code to the very device I am signing in on. In addition, submitting my claims are nice, but not being able to follow up on them on the app is rediculous. I then have to make the effort to sign in to another platform to do it. Have everything in one place

Update - it's been 2 years since my first review and now in 2022, I still find this app difficult to navigate. The options are limited and there is no way to add an explanation about your claim. If you use the app on your phone, you won't know why a claim was disallowed. You have to use the website or call them. I waited 2 months for a reply to my claim but it never came until I contacted them via phone. I needed a physicians note so they could have built in some type of response mechanism.

User experience of this app is really bad. Sometimes app blocks itself completely until I update it. Every screen takes time to load blocking everything, I tried to restart the app and had to login again, wasting even more time. Sometimes it just shows that it's having technical difficulties. Sometimes it shows huge agreements that I have to scroll. All I want just a quick access to my coverage card, I guess a photo is better 🤷‍♂️

Technical difficulties, then endless T&C's that is shown every each time on start, and if you'd want to really read it, you'd spend more time reading it than using the actual app. So you eventually give up and accept anything they put there. If you don't, your profile information is deleted from the phone and you need to initialize the app as if you never been in. And then there's the app. Ok for quick check, anything more advanced and you would be redirected to the web. Yay

No photo claims. Also drop down menu when I want to make a claim says my name or other then next only has dentist as provider and then under dentist has crowns or bridges. This is a very hard app to navigate. Update . Still can't access any thing but bridges and dental. No physio, acupuncture, massage etc. So what good is this app. Uninstalled and use the website.

Can't do everything through the app and you may be require to go online. Most recent update caused a nightmare as I could not submit a claim for over a week and made calling them useless. Overall wished the app was capable of what the online system is as the agents push you to the app anyway. I am also not interested in how they now push products.

Displays information that I don't care about, which makes it frustrating to navigate and submit claims. Coordinated benefits, good luck. Makes you rate your providers (why?). Ads are annoying. Click on "remember me" for sign in, doesn't work. For such a large company, the SunLife platform is outdated. They need to do better in all areas of user interface.

This app somehow manages to be even less functional than the Sun Life website. It crashes almost every time I try to sign in, and regularly requires more than one attempt before I'm able to access my account and claims. The interruptive marketing and promotional pop ups are frustrating. I don't understand how such a large organization can be so consistent in delivering such a poor digital user experience.

I am not able to make a benefits claim for several days and there's no indication why. None of the sun life social media accounts mention when the "maintenance" will be over either nor do they mention that one is even happening at all. Today they unlocked the ability to start a claim but by the time I reach the end of the submission there's a new "sorry, it's not available" message. How frustrating!

Many areas of the app direct you to log into the full site because it has features the app doesn't. Sometimes information is hidden and there's nothing telling you that you need to log in to the website to see what's missing. Have fun scrolling through pages of agreements every time you log in or submit anything. It's a more limited / worse experience than using the full website in a browser on your phone. They made one noticeable update: now it begs you to rate their app (it's still bad)

The app should give you the option to upload supporting documents whe the claim is submitted instead of telling you afterwards it is required (I knew the Rx was required when I submitted but didn't have the option to submit it). Should also have the ability to coordinate benefits. Now I will have to submit separately. Other than that it was wasy to use.
If you and your spouse are on the same health plan, it’s impossible to enter their information into the app to coordinate a claim. This is very counterintuitive.

Easy to navigate, fantastic to call Sunlife (they already know who is calling when you call from the app, so saves time), but not eveything is available through the app yet and it appears to me they do way too much maintenance as it is not available all the time (we get the message the app is not available to try it later).

Many features are not accessible on the app that are only acceptable on the web page. It's incredibly annoying that Sun Life goes out of his way to hide certain forms on its website and app because they probably don't want you to make a claim. It took a very long time for me to find out where to find a Dr authorization form for medication. There's also limited categories when making a claim. When Earth would "dental" not be listed as one of the categories for making a claim?!!

Cant enter the treatment duration, it assumes 60 mins and often pays out incorrect amount as a result. Doesnt save new provider information and makes me reenter it ever single time. Denies claims to places previously direct billed for misc issues such as "address not matching" and when the business or client calls to confirm details all details match, upload "send documents" link wasnt working and sunlife instead of contacting clients who had submitted documents for reassesment did nothing.

I used the call option in the app because they got rid of the chat feature which is very inconvenient. The customer service person was incredibly rude. She was talking to me as if I was trying to fight with her right from the start of the conversation raising her voice, etc. I was just asking a question. There is nowhere to write feedback. This really shouldn't be happening to anyone.

Taking pictures within app is not working. Can't add an electronic invoice (PDF format), it accepts only pictures. Annoying pop-up to rate providers. The app isn't supporting the same features as the desktop application. When trying to submit a claim upon providing all required information, the app is crashing. Reaching out to the staff, they're asking to use the web application.

Once setup with your personal info, the app is easy to follow through and submit claims. Additional February 2022... Now that Sunlife doesn't allow Telus Health to manage payment through the service providers, we must pay for the massage out of pocket and get paid back. Normally not a problem, but since the app assumes I had a 1 hour massage, it will not pay the full amount I submit. Very frustrating trying to get full payment. If/when this is fixed I'll update this review.

During benefit claim submission, the app sets default values it doesn't show the user. I submitted a claim for a 30 minute treatment but wasn't given the option of selecting appointment duration, so the app submitted it as a one hour treatment without telling me! Meaning this app causes users to submit false claims with NO way of knowing it's occurring. More concerns but not enough room to type them out in this text box. 1 Star.

I'd rate is zero stars but not an option. Can't login although user ID and password are correct (can log in fine on a laptop). App keeps showing "there's a problem at the Sunlife end". Tried calling support and after 1 hour on hold was told there's nothing wrong 🙄

Difficult to fill out. Told me the file was too big when I added the receipt photo. I had to start from the very beginning to do it again. All screens were different than the first time. Second time, it accepted photo of prescription and receipt.

This is a great app for quick reference and submitting claims, to a point. Not being able to upliad claims for equipment/service providers without a Canadian address and having to snail mail the invoice is incredibly frustrating. In today's e-commerce world ordering glasses from Zenni for example is way cheaper, easier, and cost effective, but printing, mailing and waiting for 6+weeks to process is backwards in today's e-world. Really need to update.

No way to view typed password after typing it, also deletes your text field if you switch windows before submitting. No idea why that is a 'feature'. Considering there are rediculous requirements for what is an "acceptable" password, not being able to either check if you typed it properly by viewing or or check any notes before submitting is a true disservice to the paying insuree using this platform. You also only have a couple attempts before your account is suspended. Wish I could rate 0.

Can't get through to sunlife from overseas; none of the numbers provided work from abroad, and I'm told I'm not able to do what I need to do through messaging. The app doesn't allow me to view my account number either, so if I was miraculously able to get through to somebody I would have a hard time getting access to my account. Overall really bloody frustrating.

When u get password wrong, it clears out your username! So annoyed. After updating, my remembered password is forgot. What's the point?? Also, I can't find a support number anywhere on the web. Only way to get their number is through their stupid app. I don't want to have your stupid app on my phone

I have just submitted a claim where the software did not provide the opportunity for me to send a picture of the Dr referral. Now they will reject the claim & tell me they need a Doctors referral to Physiotherapy. Total waste of time. This program sucks! Frustrated and fed up

I absolutely detest this app. It's completely inefficient, asking for the same info over and over when submitting claims. Adding new providers is also a pain, given that you know you are entering details (addresses etc.) that hundreds of people have already added before you (use a look up list!). It also provides almost no details on recent claims and those recent claims don't seem to go back for more than 3 months. The amount of coverage for physio is unclear... I could go on. Please fix!!

STILL A PROBLEM : The app has one major flaw - it won't allow coordination of benefits. This is an extremely common thing - it's baffling that it's not supported. The lack of the option means I always have to log into the website rather than use the app. Other than that - it's great.

If you kind find an option, ie:orthotics and you hit the back button, it asks if you want to leave. You click no and it doesn't allow for any other options except to say yes and then you lose everything. I have had to start over 3 times. About to try again.

Very inaccurate coverage details. You cab look up a medication it can say covered 80% and then when you check out its much lower and they say "we only cover the generic". Which would be fine if the app didn't tell you 80% coverage. If the app is going to give information it should be accurate or removed.

Some options are really nice, however the Contact Us acts like a virus - hence an UNTRUSTWORTHY app. The page does not display any useful contact information whatsoever and does NOT respect the phone settings and instead insists on using the phone manufacturers bloatware to attempt a phone call. This is very bad software development in line with sneaky hackers practices. Uninstalled. FIX THIS SECURITY BREACH!!!! If this gets corrected, I'll update this review accordingly and re-consider install.

Uploading files, something that is often required by insurance companies, is not intuitive. I had to do the action more than once because I accidentally pressed "Next" and there was no way to go back and add more images, nor to cancel. App randomly crashes. Not all information is on the app, and I need to log into the website to see some messages from SunLife, defeating the purpose of the app.

Slow and clutzy. After attaching a jpg document the app would not allow me to expand the image on my phone so I could ensure the correct file was attached. Ended up having to use an old-school magnifying glass so I could (barely) read the tiny writing on the screen. Image expansion should be built-in like in so many other apps do. A "Human Factors 101" fail.

Need to add option for PDF instead of just jpegs for documents. The app randomly quits due to technical difficulties while trying to fill in the details for claims. I have to close the app and redo my entries quite often. But in general the app is detailed and good to use. Contains more useful information about benefits then some of their competitors. It is a four out of five if you add PDFs for attaching documents

reviews.t: Cannot submit coordination of benefits with app
reviews.x: Cannot submit coordination of benefits with app

You need to call for supporrt to type codes that aren't listed. Actions or requests that are common should be listed in topics like healthcare, investments, profile, etc. and should be pre linked to the codes. Tried to download a Statement of investment for tax proposes on mobile app... can't find it. Horrible interface and menus when you can't find what you need easily

Great app! Easy to use and super convenient. One day I couldn't find my benefit card at a new pharmacy, I was able to pull a full photo of the card on my phone. I preferred when we could do scripts as well as medical and specialized care, but I didn't take a star off for that, as I believe that is the choice of the employer. I use this often, I find the information useful and super handy. I love the option of taking and attaching photos of claims instantly Great idea. Perfect app .

This app is constantly improving. The missing star is because when you look at recent claims, the service date and other details are not available. This is important when you have more than one claim to enter for the same provider and you forgot which one you already entered.

I couldn't update any info unless I logged on a PC. How is that useful? Its my account, it's my information and you block me from updating something I can do from my phone. Absolutely useless as long as a "need" for the PC log in is required. Might as well not have an app otherwise.

This app is super easy to use! I was skeptical because in the past benefit sites tend to be very cumbersome. Not this one!! So easy to add your photos for the expense. Adding new providers is also very easy! I like how they make it easy to add postal codes!! Very impressive! I can do everything from my phone! I can't say enough about it!!

Great app. They just need to fix the Provinces that are available on the dropdown for this to receive a higher rating (turns out that on certain smartphones you just need to "scroll" within the menu, down to see more options, but it is not obvious at all). They could also use a simple trick with the camera for entering service provider addresses a lot faster. But otherwise, this is a really good app, and I appreciate how fast and easy it is to submit a claim.

App is not well done although it IS convenient and has great potential. No option to pull up same provider you've used before (unless perhaps only in past 90days) and basic probs like the screen not scrolling for data entry with keyboard block the entry fields. Info for coverage does not match plan details. Non standard use of standard prompts (such as back arrow that should go to prior screen but cancels). Excessive agreement prompts - record the agreement and notify. Don't ask every time.

Very poor app in terms of zero capabilities for a user to view details on past claims (even those submitted through the app), no capability to see running totals or balances of remaining coverage, frequently glitches when submitting claims so that they appear to not have been proceed when they acutally are. The only thing this app is barely good for is submitting a claim, but even then it would be nice to have the option to upload a receipt and provide more details on the claim. Terrible.

When making a claim, let me add documents during the initial filling out process. Tired of having to file a claim and then reopening the file to add receipts, if they are required, allow them to be added at the beginning. Pretty simple idea considering you deny the claim every time without the receipts.

It does not let you type in the full name of the service provider, needs more characters in the space, is too short. It does not let you type in what is the specific product or service. Just putting in "medical product or service" is not specific enough. Also, if you change screens on your phone, it logs you out and you have to start inputting the info all over again! For example if you leave the SunLife app to take the receipt photos--SunLife logs you out and doesn't save what you just input!

I really like the app. Have used it twice. Took a little time to understand the steps the first time, piece of cake 2nd time round. Very convenient. No stamps for mail and you can track the claim right on the app. I scored it 4 stars because I didn't think that finding the provider was clear. It took me a few tries.

Edit: For what this app does, it's great. I no longer expect it to provide explanations for issues, e.g. documents required. On multiple occasions the app told me that my reimbursement was less than I knew it was supposed to be without telling me why. I have had to call Sun Life for more information, or to get it straightened out. Not sure if these design elements have been updated, but I no longer expect them to be provided in this app, so I'm happy with the convenience this app does provide.

Every time I submit a claim I have to re-enter the location. The "select location" drop-down menu only shows 3 locations (none of them entered by me) and won't scroll down. There seems to be no way to edit the list of locations. A minor but annoying bug. RESOLVED.

Easy breezy app. I like how I can use my fingerprint for login. Finding a practitioner has never been easier. Submission are quick, easy to upload documents but they aren't needed. You can also check: coverage, info remaining balances. I also like that my investments, health insurance and lifetime is all in one place!

Attaching documents to insurance claims couldn't be more difficult. It requires a pen and a pad to keep track of unnecessaroly long IDs, because there's no "list documents" function under claims. Taking pictures of receipts has to happen outside of the app which is unnecessary, and gives yet another thing to keep track of. Having visibility on which invoices are attached to which claims is virtually impossible. I've been on the phone for support more times than i can count. Character limit hit..

This app is complete trash. No notifications from them about plan payments, the "contact us" phone number doesn't send you to the correct department, constant notifications for things that are not related to my service. No way to change to email vs paper. SunLife in general communications are garbage.

Buggy app (throws you put when trying to attach a photo from the library instead of taking it with a camera - forces one to print e-receipt to then take a photo of it with a phone cam...) Lots of providers not searchable. Have to manually enter their data from the receipt. I hope these bugs fixes and improvements will be done so one can use the app for efficiently.

Grest app, user friendly and pretty much idiot-proof so even i could use it! Saves paper, postage and time. Discovered that there is not enough space to enter an institution's full name when submitting a claim. I just submitted one and am now not sure whether it will be processed as I couldn't input the full name.

This app is does exactly what it's supposed to. I like that I can submit claims, review coverage, and access resources right through the app. I don't like how some things (anything related to the account) *have* to be done through the website, and mobile doesn't count. For a lot of people, their phone is their PC. I was able to access those specific things on a tablet, though.

The app works ok, but the initial signing in process is terrible (security features that is nonsense). The "security" feature wherein your entered username or password are cleared if you switch apps is annoying. A lot of people use password managers so switching to another app to copy the username/password to the clipboard is very common and frankly increases security since better passwords will be used.

Too many errors in the app: once all documents uploaded you need to start all over again. I'm obligated to use because of my employer but if for me, this kind of errors are a reflection of the functionality of their system. Also, they suggest service providers that are not eligible for reimbursement. I'm being very kind to submit 1 star.

Decent app. I don't like that after I've found a good therapist they keep trying to get me to find cheaper ones. Cheaper does not necessarily mean better. Also Why do I have to rate my therapist after each and every appointment? I've been told that isn't so but it won't move to the next screen until I put in the number of stars.

Gets the job done. But is not easy navigating the medical benefits part of the app. Unclear options for medical topics. Also no way to cancel a claim after submitting it. For that you have to call in. Spent over an hour waiting for someone to come on the phone and then had to be transferred and waited about 20 minutes. An option to delete / recall a claim can save a lot of time and money for both sides.

It provides basic coverage information but if you need any details or try the virtual assistant, it's just a long waiting game for the answer of "I don't know, the plan provider has to call and inquire". Plus it doesn't remember your password on an Android device. Posting receipts is convenient and overall works well (though often you have to add providers manually first as their list of providers is limited)

It's not a bad app at all, though sometimes it gets frustrating while filling out forms and is not very accessible for people with disability. The checkboxes are small and sometimes the cursor gets stuck on one option of form and doesnt move to the nex option unless you go to the previous option and then choose the one you want. There is opportunity to enhance forms.

App has been significantly improved, I certainly appreciate the changes. Easy to submit claims (so far), it's nice having a provider search and getting discounts to services associated with SunLife. It's nice having access to coverage info but it is a little maze like if you're looking for anything outside of standard medical & dental & coverage details could be worded more clearly. Otherwise they've done a good job improving app, enough that I've changed from a 3 to 4 star rating

Easy to use and submit claims. Helpful in finding resources such as Healthcare providers etc. I've only noticed one issue lately is that there is no section in medical services for specifying Compound Creams. I understand they are covered by drug benefit at the regular percentage however the pharmacy I get my compound cream requires up front payment. I have been able to make claims but it's a bit challenging. I would like to see the app include special prescriptions.

Good app, fairly easy to navigate, not sure if my senior parents could figure it out.. It has a few capabilities that the sunlife web login does not, namely the ability to submit medical equipment claims which i thought odd. Perhaps an effort to get customers to download the app?

Not super friendly. Cannot upload PDF. Either the app or the people processing the claim keep making mistakes so that I have to resubmit claims 2 to 3 times if the service provider requires a doctor's prescription before they finally accept it (even if I submit it with the prescription everytime. Annoying. Poor service. Making me lose time. I wish my employer used another provider so I didn't have to deal with them.

The app user friendliness and speed is good but the only issue I noticed the app has is that it is missing bunch of information that my profile on the sunlife website has but they are missing from the app so I have to keep going back and forth between the app and website. For example, under coverage information in the app, there is zero information about dental coverage but all that info is available on the website. Once all the information from the website gets added to the app, then it's great

This app is easy to use but unfortunately Sunlife also uses this app to not pay on time. I used to be able to submit a claim and it would be paid within 2 days. Now i submit a claim, can't attach a receipt at the same time (because supposedly receipts on record), my claim gets denied because they want a copy of the receipt..EVERY SINGLE TIME...so then EVERY CLAIM takes close to another 9 days to process. This app is supposed speed up claims not slow them down.

As the years go on I've been audited due to sunlife errors. As well, the steps to submit claims and reimbursement have become more complicated and difficult. As a 35 year old sales professional this process has been difficult to say the least. I can only imagine how difficult it is for the less technically inclined and elderly. Do better Sunlife

Overall, the app works well. I have 2 complaints though. The first is that while filling out the information about a paramedical claim, each time I enter a value in a field I have to wait for a few seconds while a spinner comes up, which is annoying. Second, can you PLEASE stop asking me to rate every single provider, and the same provider over and over and over again. At least provide a setting to disable this prompt.

Terrible login experience. Timeout happens when you're not actively in the app. Fingerprint resets. Most used features are deep in the app, not on the front page. Provider information doesn't get saved so you need to re-enter over and over (I assume you dissuade you from claiming). Cooperations, please do not use Sunlife for your staff.

It's ridiculous that you have to sign into the website for certain activities, like retrieving messages, when everything should just be on the App and easily accessible. Time to get with the times, if I can complete my banking on an App. My health claims should be just as easy.

The camera for taking pictures is garbage. I had to exit the application and use the camera on my phone because otherwise the pictures were all blurry. Also they don't let you upload files, only photos. So I couldn't upload the pdf receipt that was emailed to my from the provider. I had to download the pdf and then screenshot it and upload the photo of the screenshot. When inputting the provider name there is a character limit. Otherwise it is fine and Sunlife is responsive.

Don't understand why the app and ask if you want to add a remaining amount of your claim on your health spending account and does not carry any of the information over. Also a number of other odd quirks that make this app not very user friendly. It is better than no app but still can be frustrating to use. I do like being able to use the camera to scan receipts. However, there are still ways of not getting your full entitlements.

Trying to submit a claim, I realized that the options are too specific in the app, none of which what I need for my claim.. So, I still had to call and wait on hold to talk to a person. Also, set up a fingerprint so I don't have to enter a password every time, but it refused my fingerprint, cleared my password.. and then told me that my *correct* password was actually incorrect.. locking my account. When 'resetting', it refused to accept that same password as, it was my 'previous' password. Hmmm

So grateful to be able to file claims quickly and efficiently without going through the mail. It's faster to send, process and respond to requests for more information from Sun Life. It saves me a lot of anxiety associated with sending documents through the mail. App work efficiently. I would appreciate a save function so you could start a claim and finish it later. I find if I pause mid-claim, the app times out and I have to restart the claim. Otherwise, no complaints.

STILL does not store the name of the provider!!! Anyone listening?? Must re-enter every time. Even directly after having entered it because you have several receipts from same provider....can't even access other providers saved on the website! Also the fact that you cannot access any messages you may have on the app is fairly inept - "please login to sunlife.ca" - what is the point of the app if you cannot accomplish everything in one location. SunLife accessibility still has a long way to go

Very difficult to navigate, can't attached medical notes as required. Telephone helo provides solution but the solution does not exist. I'd rather be able to work on desk top, file electronically, print for my record and income taxes and be able to attach proper documents on desk top online...not app since it does not work

Not a bad app. Wish you could submit coordination of benefits on the app. Very easy to use though and most of the information is available at your fingertips. Would be nice to not have to rate the service provider for every time you put in a new date. Rating g does not change from one week to another.

When submitting documents, the app doesn't allow you to select a document from your phone. It only accepts a picture of the document or take a picture from camera. When you only have electronic copies of the document, it's hard to take a picture of the monitor/laptop screen. Kinda stupid.

It's an ok app but with frustrating shortcomings. First being you can't paste your password in the login form on Android. Everytime you switch from your password manager app back to the sunlife, it clears the login form. Second is that photo submission is limited to the photos folder. I want to submit from downloads as my receipt is already electronic. Support pdf too please!

User interface is sloppy and hangs often. New version also no longer works on my phone so I need to get a new phone just to use the app or use someone else's - and I don't even see a difference from the previous version. Not enthused about giving high ratings for *this* program...

The app is very responsive and fast. However, it's lacking a few key options: 1. When uploading pictures there's no way to access Google Photos. 2. PDFs cannot be uploaded 3. The Recent Claims is very basic information and you have to go to the website to find the details.

Version 5.19 is now useless. I can't log in. They have (intentionally?) disabled the ability to paste a password into the password field. I use random passwords and secure a password keeper app. My passwords are very difficult to enter on a mobile device. I was able to paste in the previous versions of this app. Please bring this feature back. I won't compromise on the security of my passwords by making them easy to type. This latest change has made the app no good to me.

My list of providers dissapeares often. I have a number of them saved and when I go to make a claim the names are gone. It's rather frustrating that I have to keep checking to see when the glitch has sorted itself out. I dont want to forget to make a claim. I tried two times yesterday and once today and finally on my second attempt today the names all showed up.

No option to only send a requested document. Notification visible on web only but not on app so I am not able to upload the document. Can't reach Sunlife on phone. Have sent a requested prescription on a different case with the exact details as required. Now Sunlife requests a totally different document too with other details. It looks they do not want to pay me back with this behaviour! 2 years now! Extremely disappointed with Sunlife organisation and partially with the app!!

I'm out of words for how bad my experience was with this app and the company itself, can't connect to my app, tells me to go on the website to complete registration, doesn't work so they tell me to contact them and when I do well they couldn't help all they can do is reset password. They are paid to reset people's password and can't help for anything else so I need to wait 4 days until I receive a call from someone "higher" who could possibly help.

It logs me out after a few minutes and does not "remember me", even my login name. It forces me to accept the EULA every time, even if I am logging in after a few minutes, after being forced out. It forces me to review the two screen orientation to the app every time I log in, which is usually a few minutes after inactivity. I get that security or private information is important, but this is lunacy.

After having used this app over the last year, I'm disappointed that I am unable to tell if I have already submitted an older service. I.e. I can't remember which claims I've submitted but I can't look up any past claims for that service. That means I run the risk of accidentally submitting the same receipt twice.

Not helpful, every step way harder than it should be to withdraw investments. No option to withdraw overseas apart from calling and being on hold for 30 min on overseas calling rates. No chat or email option so it starts to feel like they are just trying to make it as difficult as possible to remove your investment.

I would prefer to just be able to upload documents from website. On app can only upload photos. So ended up sending a photo of the pdf receipt my provider emailed me because was unable to upload a simple pdf scanned document! Would much prefer if app and website were more aligned in function / set up. It's very frustrating

Very quick and easy to use, and nice that it instantly calculates what your reimbursement will be. It would be nice if there was a way to more efficiently enter multiple repeated services with the same provider, rather than having to enter them one by one.

The app is way better than the website! You can upload receipts in some cases. However, little things, like submitting the rest of the amount to HSA - the amount should be auto-filled in. Also you cant tell which claim goes with which receipt which makes it challenging when I'm trying to double check and cross reference numerous receipts. Please keep working on it!

You ask me to agree to your user agreement literally everytime i sign on. Your login screwn is frustrating. When i accidentally click my email, it completely erases it making me type it in again. Your remember me function is remembering an email that i dont use for this app.and if i dont sign in at least once a month your app makes me change my password.

Terrible app. Disappointing effort from a company with their financial means. Unable to attach receipts in DOC or PDF format to submissions; only photos. Somehow they've developed an app that won't allow the camera on the phone to focus! (My 2 banking apps take nice clean photos of cheques; this is only a problem with Sunlife which has no ability to focus).

Not use friendly and keeps crashing. You can find a list of providers but no option to add them as a provider so you need to add everything by hand. It also doesn't load providers from the sun Life website, you need to add again all the providers you have listed in your account on the main website. So frustrating.

It's hard to claim, and to understand what you are covered for. There is no in-app customer service to reach out too like other insurance apps. You have to access the web version for a lot of different needs which defeats the purpose of the mobile use. It does not a have a seamless user friendly interface.

Yah, life may be brighter with this app and Sunlife as an insurer. It was extremely simple to submit a claim on this app. The company has been generally very polite and quite responsive and supportive to deal with. Claims are generally fast and efficient with the app and through more traditional processes. It doesn't seem like they are trying to find every possible way to not pay out for insurance or to stall on paying. So far, so good. I might have to get my shades out.

You can't upload receipts. You have to take a photograph and upload the photo which means if you do everything online you have to print a receipt in order to take a photo to be able to upload it only to throw it away 2 seconds later. What a joke, waste of time AND paper!! It also cannot do everything the website can and vice versa so you're stuck having to use and figure out both. A total and completely disorganized mess!!

While it's great that I can submit my claim through the app, I still have to log onto the website to find out why my claim wasn't paid out. That just makes it annoying. Also, the fact that I have to take a picture of my receipt instead of being able to attach a document, especially when my providers only send me electronic copies of my receipts, is both annoying and wasteful.

reviews.t: So much untapped possibilities that aren’t leveraged
reviews.x: The app does not provide explanations when a claim is not approved and you are consistently forced to go back to website to get more info. The app, when you are processing a claim, often does not request for the required documents and you are forced to start a new parallel process, memorized a long claim number (since the copy and pace feature is disabled) and submit the documents. Recently I’m having issues processing my claims. Despite that add the required documents, my claims take over 15 business to be processed and often with no rational, which forces me to call to get them resolved. My claims are then submitted to another department which adds up to the overall time to process my claims... No chat feature through the app and in its current form. In its current format, the apps is pretty much useless and total waste of time.

Can't view messages sent/received from desktop site. Can't view all coverage info i.e. dental. Stop pestering me to rate providers i have never received a helpful recommendation from the app on a provider to use. I already use my company's preferred provider and you keep suggesting I could save more by going elsewhere? Illogical. Submitting estimates , documents and Bill's through the app does work well though for what features it allows. And quicker way to see claims info than desktop.

Virtually every time that I use the app to file a claim, I encounter a problem. Submit a claim, I know that I need to provide a doctor’s note but it doesn’t ask for it upfront, so it gets rejected and I have to submit it again later. Or I have to guess at what is missing because it isn’t specific. As is the case today. Mailing the forms may take more time but it seems to be much more effective.

App Is junk!!! always needs to be updated and they still don’t have all options available online?!! It’s 2020, why are we still having to mail our benefit forms in???!! Most of the customer service is awful too Technology is great, use it!!

reviews.t: Mobile app has NO CO-ORDINATION OF BENEFITS!
reviews.x: Called today to find out why, suddenly this year we have NO co-ordination of benefits. Our plan has gone from a 100% coverage to a 90% coverage and no one at sunlife can figure it out that this is required! What a rag tag outfit, I can’t believe that this is such a shock to anyone that works there. My wife and I both work at the same company and now have to waste time to submit our claims on the website rather than the mobile app! If sunlife thinks this will discourage me from claiming what is supposed to be mine, they are sorely mistaken! Thanks for NO help by your customer care people as well.

Consistantly does not work. Always getting a message saying its experiencing technical difficulties and that I need to try again later. They also don't let you view or submit claims under a personal spending account. You still have to physically mail in your claim for that. It's 2020! Update your app already!

As you submit a claim it doesn't ask to include any documents. My claim went straight to completed status and said $0 reimbursed with a note saying "only add documents that we ask for, check the website"... I called support and they told me I had to add a photo of the prescription, it will then be processed in 6 to 10 days. What's the point of this app, it's not making anything easier...

This is a handy app. Navigation is very good notwithstanding the limitations of data entry from a smartphone. But the fact that I can do it from my smartphone is really fantastic if you think about it. I did see that I can just take a picture of the receipt now. I have not tried that yet but if that works as well as I hope then that will be truly excellent.

Works ok but it is frustrating that you have to use both the app and their webpage to process and or review claims. Would be nice if they had the full functionality in both. For example if a claim requires additional information you need to sign on to the website to find out what they are looking for and then go back to the app to upload the document. It's almost as if they make it purposely difficult to get reimbursed.

The app is not aligned with the website. Website doesn't allow me to provide documentation. The app allows me to do that, but I must first contact the call center to provide me with a code. I can also only upload jpg, not pdf....so large documents must be uploaded one by one. Very frustrating. Who is the product owner for this app?

Makes submissions so much better, and get you faster return. Can't ever go back to paper forms. It saves your care providers automatically every time you submit a new claim. Nice app, not sure what else it would need besides the ability to modify our profile directly from it. Or maybe add a new family member.

I was so very frustrated with Sunlife. It took me over 6 months to get paid as they kept playing games trying to get me to give up and walk away from $1600. They never sent me any email notifications to submit receipts and so the first correspondence I had with them was a letter that my electronic submissions were suspended.. then I sent them the receipts but with the wrong front cover page.. so they declined it and I had to resubmit again with the proper cover page, then QA got involved.

Sub par app. I find that things I am looking for with regards to my benefits, I can't find in the app. There is no list of medications paid for other than the most recent claims, which is not helpful. I can't find a spot which tells me when the next dental checkup should be. Payment of prescriptions days as per plan but no details. I like that I can call the company from the app and don't need to have my cards with me.

Just spent an hour registering and figuring out my member ID# versus the account number versus sign in code, but on the plus side entering postal codes was surprising convenient with how the number pad would pop up? This is coming from someone who is bored to tears by insurance and technology in general. After the registering, this app has been a dream; extremely user friendly. I like that it saves/remembers info to make repeat appointments easier to submit.

Claim submission is very quick and easy, writing an online review takes longer. When documents are required, you can take a photo using your phone. You can even submit some claim types through this app that you cannot do from the website. I found one disadvantage compared to their website; when submitting from there, you have an option to "Use available HSA for remaining claim amount the is not covered by your coverage amount". Please add this for a 5 star rating.

So much easier to use this app to submit claims, an easy 5 stars. One thing I wish were possible would be automatic submissions of claims if you need to pick up a medication Daily or at least having a preset you can select so you don't need to keep filling out the same info all the time.

I had a challenge to submit documents yesterday because the app requested a code, which was unnecessary as I had selected "recent claims" through the app. I didn't know I could ignore this step and be able to proceed to the "camera window" to be able to upload my pictures, until I called the call centre. Very frustrating!

This app doesn't let you submit claims for podiatrist. So you have to go to the website, but then you can't attach a photo on the website so then you basically have to wait until they decline you to add a "savings opportunity" photo AFTER and then wait another week. It's a pretty ridiculous process of back and forth on the website and on the app. It really should be easy but it's not. It's not accessible AT ALL. I have my masters and I can't figure out this app. It's not good at all.

This was a horrible experience. The setup of my account took way to long, almost like they didn't want me to sign up. When I called in I was on hold for 54 minutes, and then the person on the other end was impatient and very abrupt. Not that I can blame him, if every person who phones in has this kind of experience the phone calls must not be pleasant.

I have 123 apps installed, and this one is by far the worst. But at the end of the day, it really doesnt matter because there is no alternative to it. Needs to be updated Everytime you use it for some reason. constantly forgets my log in credentials. demands that i rate the app even after ive already rated it. In addition, the app does not have nearly as much information as the website, which makes it near useless since they deny most of your claims without any details. Its a really bad app.

The app works great for what it does and seems stable on my Google Pixel 2, but it would be nice if they'd add more of the website tools. It's pretty limited and the tools that are there force you to leave the app, and are mostly links to general advice articles.

Limited options. Cannot look at recent claims past a few months. And for some reason the app is the only way to submit documents. Why is there no equivalent way to do this using a browser on a pc? Overall, your typical level of service expected from an insurance provider to make access to your benefits more difficult at best or impossible at worst.

Sometimes you get locked out and can't sign back in. And you can't upload original receipts requested on the website. To not delay your claim, I would be tempted to submit by paper because it's unpredictable when the app works and when it doesn't. It's been frozen for me several times.

Since the last update, the app is unstable and perpetually crashes. Sometimes it crashes on startup, sometimes on logging in, sometimes on the "I agree" usage screen. Can't say if it crashes past that point because that's as far as I can ever get. I have reinstalled it several times, rebooted my phone, cleared caches, etc., and still no luck getting it to work. If I could give it zero stars, I would.

Does not remember me so I have to enter password any time. Options like take a picture are deep in the menu. Referral from doctor has to be mailed outo instead of take a picture and submit. When you login you get first to read many screens and agree with it. Not sure if there would be any change in it since previous time. So takes a long time to submit or lookup anything. Compared with other apps this is bad. Have a good day. Theo

I've just downloaded this app and have only used it once so far but I wanted to leave a review right away! It was super easy to use, with clear, helpful, step-by- step directions. This app allows me to download pictures of receipts and submit claims that I wasn't otherwise able to do on their website and I would have had to fill out a paper expense claim form and mail it in. So...I am one happy camper!

When compared to other insurance apps, this one definitely needs improvement. I would say it only works 70% as well. For example i can check my coverage balance for some things but not massage therapy for some strange reason. It just isnt on any of the lists.

It's ok. Claims submitted are easy to do but the return takes a while. I've been told by co workers that 48 to 72 hours was the max. Sometimes I experience a week and a bit. Some issues you need to log into the actual website which kind of defeats the purpose of the app. Could be for security reasons. Needs huge improvements regarding notifications that may be urgent.

This app is so easy to use and a real time saver. It has eliminated so much paperwork and made my claim submissions a breeze. What would be great is allowing the user to permit reporting a coordinated claim with a different insurer. In other words provide a field where any refund amount provided by a different insurer could be reported.

It would be very useful to have an option for Sun Life to provide information on why a claim is not being reimbursed inside the app. I shouldn't need to call in to learn that my receipts are too blurry, or incorrect because they don't have certain required information on them. It would be so much easier and reduce call times for the call centre if this information was available through the app. Clients could also be requested to contact Sun Life for more information if this is appropriate.

I love it, so easy to use. And receiving the reimbursement for short period of time. I would like to suggest something, would it be possible to have comment box for certain claim. examples: claim amount error by reception and been submitted then remaining charge the following week. Thank you!

I love how fast it is to submit claims on this app, especially the subsequent visits when your practitioner info is saved. I feel it functions well overall. And get your money back so quickly! I always forgo getting my benefits at the point of purchase, pay in full with credit card to gain points, get reimbursed basically the next business day or two. Would love to submit a massage that's over an hour, manually without having to submit a picture.

You can do some stuff here, sort of. You can sign in and look at things & certain claims can be submitted through the app. Problem is, most things require you to actually log into the website, so not sure why I'm wasting space on my phone with this? I can't even check my plan through here. It directs me to the full website, where I have to sign in again. Not sure if this next part is an app issue or a Sunlife issue, but when I submit a claim, I'm told I'll get an email when it's processed. Lie.

It's super easy to use and I found the service provider list very beneficial. I was able to find a very good massage therapist close to home. Even though my massage therapist doesn't do direct billing this app makes it almost as easy. It takes less than 2 minutes to submit a claim.

It's annoying that after you log in it pops up again to tell you it timed you out. Definately doesn't follow the three click rule. At least 7 to do anything. Edit: after already reviewing the app I got another pop up. I'm lowering by 1 star for additional hassle. Edit 2: one of the updates had made this wildly unstable and on a monthly basis I am unable to log in. Not just weekends during what may be maintenance periods but during the week. Not confidence inspiring for a money manager.

App login was down. Had to try 3 times before being able to sign in. System not very user friendly on how to figure out what category to use for something which could not be done online which was annoying. In order to do a rating had to log back in rather than immediately being able to do a rating.

Used the app to submit a claim for the first time - it's not bad, but there are definitely areas for improvement. Like the idea of being able to submit claims via an app. Areas for improvement: 1) Add a provider while submitting a claim - why can't I search and add or add from my fav providers? 2) Keyboard switches between letters and numbers when typing in postal code - disorienting 3) Have to attach a photo for receipt. Should allow PDF.

The Sun Life App is not user friendly. When asked on their website to upload documents to the app, one cannot give any written details, but can only take pictures of forms and upload. One cannot "attach" documents like in an email. Plus, when needing to upload a document, one must quote the long claim number so a pen and paper is needed to recall it in advance. Sun Life, please improve the app.

Horrible! The app doesn't explicitly show me the contact number nor my member ID. I have to guess at what these numbers are based on the 20-digit number on my card! Secondly, if I want to call in, it makes me call using my cell phone. Why won't it just show me the phone number? I don't have cheap services with my cell phone so is rather use my land line. Thirdly, you can look up benefits, but not all of them, that would be too easy. You have to either check online or your member booklet. Useles

Difficulty with your app. I was attempting to submit a claim and when I got to the postal code area I didn't know it so I had to go look it up.I had already entered the first three digits and when I went back to the page to enter the last three it could not be done. I tried two or three times and every time I did it I couldn't enter any more numbers or letters finally I started all over again and then was able to do it

Generally well thought out but has glitches. When logging in, it shows a sign saying there are no claims in process, even though there are: you have to enter the home page, look for the option there and then realize you have to tap on the 2nd tab (the one that looks disabled). And it doesn't seem to control the camera well: it could not take picture of a receipt, it always looks blurry on the preview. But at least you can take it elsewhere then use the app to choose it from the photo gallery

Prescription drugs is a very common claim, yet they don't have that category in the app. Customer service said to use "healthcare and supplies", which on the website claims page is a completely different thing. Every time you navigate away from the app (i.e. to look up service provider info) you have to re-login and you lose all the claims info you enter. Very annoying and inefficient!

App is glitchy and does not offer accurate information for submission under correct policy when dealing with more than one policy. I personally find the app a pain to navigate, though I cannot compare it to anything else I have used. Takes some time to navigate and get used to.

Overall the app is convenient and easy to use for claims that don't require additional docs. I was able to attach documents easily a few months ago and can tell that the app was updated, as now I am unable to attach. I know that the claim I just submitted will be denied, because I couldn't submit the necessary docs. So this makes the app not very useful.

The app doesn't have an option to allow for submitting paramedics claims or documents. App hasn't worked properly for a while and when I brought it up with Sunlife, got told that I dont know how to use it. Of course the only other way to send documents to them is by mail, because submitting on the website, or by email address is way too easy. This company and app are both a joke.

The investment portion of the app is fine, but I'm usually using it for the benefits part, and that's where everything falls apart. I submit a claim in the app, which will be denied because you want a receipt. But the app won't tell me it's denied, I need to watch my email for that. Then I have to log in to the website to review the comments, because for some reason I can't read these in the app. But I can't submit a receipt to the website, I can only do it through the app. Also, the app doesn't let me submit PDFs of receipts, only photos. So I need to open digital receipts on a computer, export them as images, and transfer them to my phone. Either that or physically print my receipts and take a photo of them. The whole process is just unnecessarily complicated. There's a notifications section in the app, but that's only used for Sunlife to advertise to me, not to show me any useful notifications about my claims. I'll happily give this app 5 stars if you make it so that I can do an entire claim submission in the app.

This App is very user friendly and easy to navigate. The only thing i found a little bit confusing is that, you can not add claimes yourself from the mobile app. It tells you to login in to mysun life app while you are logged in so better to use your computer for that.

Great app, easy to use and intuitive interface. Much better than having to use the website. Love that you can submit photos of referrals/receipts. My only complaint is that when your claim has been reviewed, you have to leave the app and sign into the website to see why you're not being reimbursed or if you have to provide documents. Then go back to the app to submit them. Also, would be great if I could see a history of referrals/receipts I've submitted.

So convenient to submit claims! but thd app will too often not work with your password, forcing you to reset the password. ive had to do so 3 times in the past month. there are a few things that are missing in the way of claiming all expenses (and knowing why claims were not approved - you have to go to the website for that), but its still a great app for making things easier overall.

It's easy to use + processing is quick because of it. What i dislike the most is that i have to enter addresses + phone numbers for recurring services with the same doctors. Also, all medical institutions (clinics, hospitals, etc) should be available for selection. I should not have to enter the Queen Elizabeth's address every time.

So many things that can help out, for instance a box to leave comments or instructions to accompany a claim What if you just want to send documents? Are you supposed to make another claim? It's strange that you have a box to write a comment at the app store but no place to request or instruct inside the app. I often put explanations on paper and photo or scan it, but there is no photo op in dental, it gets really complicated. Please consider adding.

reviews.t: Very easy to submit a claim
reviews.x: After the setup of providers has been input the rest of the submission is straight forward. And it tells you right away what’s covered and reimbursed and what’s not reimbursed. I would recommend this app to all sunlife account holders because it makes everything so easy.
Great system, effective and runs smoothly. Easy to use, straight forward claim submission!
Very user friendly and very informative, intuitive. I highly recommend!!
Easier on a tablet than a phone.

Ive been able to submit my benefits claims relatively hassle free - with one exception. You still need to verfiy all banking information via Sunlife's desktop version of their website, this cannot be done through the app. Changes to information such as banking, log ins and contact info may take some time to carry over to the app. If these issues were addressed this oroduct would be better for it.

the app is tedious at best. you have to enter all information contained on the invoice by using your phone keyboard - mind numbing. if your lighting and/or camera are not sufficient for a clear pic, you will have to mail it in anyways, meaning you wasted the 30 mins initially spent. if you wait for Sun life to respond to you add another week to find out you have to mail it in anyways. NOPE, NOT AN EFFECTIVE APP OR SYSTEM TO INCREASE TURN AROUND TIME. To be fair, if you enter all the stuff from one provider in first, then reuse the same provider for multiple visits, camera pics and lighting are good, it may provide some reduced turn around time. BUT if its a new, one-off visit.. cut your losses and frustration and mail it in, its faster.

I have never in my life come accrosd such an unfriendly user interface. Trying to register my account was absolutely horrible. The app itself runs fine if you can get past the ridiculously vague sign up process and the week long wait for an access code that comes afterward. Severely disappointed.

This app needs a lot of work, primarily with user friendliness and functionality. Claim reviewer comments are not available... you must go to the website to review. Then if additional documents are required, you must go back to the app to submit them!! Not very streamlined. The camera ability could be better for submitting documents, they are darker and sometimes not clear. A smoother more logical flow for claim submission would be helpful.

It was a great app and made it so much easier to submit, unfortunately since it was updated it no longer lets me attach my receipts without crashing. I can enter all the information, but when it comes time to attach the receipt, the app crashes and shuts down. I also cannot submit certain claims through my computer, so the app is a necessity. I have attempted to contact Sunlife however the response is to submit paper claims, which is besides the point of creating an app.

Has some silly components. Frustrating that you can't make claims after 9pm (PST) -- since when does a robot have working hours? Also, when submitting a claim with multiple expenses, you can't accidentally add an extra expense, otherwise you'll have to start over again from scratch. Also, it asks you to optionally rate the provider, yet does not allow you to go to the next screen unless you do provide a rating. Otherwise, there are some user friendly features, like ease of entering postal codes.

this app is nothing but problems. No option to upload a file for digital receipts, just an option to take a photo of a paper receipt. lots of issues filling in information that the space some how doesn't accept input or just crashing....I am quite Tech capable and this is by far the worst user app I have seen to date. Obviously designed and approved by people in the industry...not from the point of view of someone on my end just trying to make a simple claim...

Decent app. Ui needs a bit of work to make it easy to use and not so complicated. For example, adding an address to your psychologist that has multiple locations is a pain in the butt when you have to manually add it into different lines instead of just tying into google maps or another service, and using that as your directory. It is also frustrating submitting claims as the whole amount claimed is generally not paid out in full even tho 100% is reimbursable??

This app is definitely better than submitting paper claims however it has some issues. The main one being that it doesn't remember providers that you have added so you always have to type in the providers full details every time. It also doesn't let you copy a previous submission and edit the details. I'm also not particularly comfortable with the app trying to suggest me alternate providers and drugs.

I've been getting some help from my psychologist and decided to try claiming my visits through this app. the signup was a little bit tricky but after I got that done I found that it was surprisingly effortless to submit claims using the application. I'm happy that I can submit them quickly and I usually get a response within a few days. it's not everyday you see an app that's this well made and easy-to-use, thank you for making this difficult time just a little bit easier.

the app doesn't even permit the sending of documents anymore although the option is advertised to be easier in an email I've receivednot long ago... I really don't understand how those two things are possible. you press on documents, it brings you to submit a new claim, it's really a dead end! You can't even tske a picture and send it with your claim number to support it. How is that easier? It's really time wasting!

No paper for the most part. There is no place to leave notes or dialogue. This leads to multiple phone calls and resubmission of claims. Basically if you submit a claim and it isn't perfect it's canceled. Then you have to call and find out why. Resubmit everything and it starts all over. Always initiate call to SunLife from within the app. Calling direct leads to general line questions and more editing.

Redundancy could easily be fixed yet not done. Submitting claims take way longer than they could; in fact, it is longer than a paper claim being filled out. Please ask your members to show you exactly what and where changes would be most helpful to the whole process. Overall not too bad.

Worse than their snail mail service. I've uploaded multiple claims and a referral/prescription. The app is useless if you're trying to coordinate benefits and it has tried to reimburse me amounts that don't make sense. It has potential, but right now I'll go back to mailing paper...and killing trees until this gets updated.

Sunlife has strange password requirements such that my normal password style is not allowed. When actually trying to do something where I need to flip between apps, such as getting a photo of the receipt, it kicks me out so that I have to log in again and re-enter details I had just entered. Makes it frustrating to use. Some of the features to reuse entries from previous successful entries is nice, and it would be nice if t went further such as offering previous payments as a suggestion.

Although, the application is not as user friendly as it first appears... It is easier to send in documents requested to process claims quicker... However, after setting up the required information and using it several times it is more user friendly than when I first used the app to submit a claim...

app idea is great but annoying to use. when entering your password & email, if you dont press next on the phone keyboard it makes you reenter everything. Dont click on the empty box to input, you must press next & then done, this then lowers the keyboard and allows you to click next on the screen. My other issue is when submitting receipts or documents. you cannot attach proof when you first submit claim. you have to wait until it is processed. often rejected even with proof, and resubmitted

Good app, quick to submit claims for my insurance. Most friction points have been alleviated (ex: fingerprint authentication, postal code letter/number keyboard alternation) but some issues still persist like only being able to see 3 random health-care providers from a much larger list when submitting claims. Fix that and u get 5 stars.

For some claims it works great. You still have to use the website for clarification though. Also, doctor's notes are not given a chance to input so a claim has to be rejected and then yiu can send the note. If they fixed that part, tje system would be much better.

Works like a bank app for e-deposit. You can submit multiple claims at a time but only for one person. You have to file that claim and start a new claim for the new person . I had to cancel the one I'd filled in when I tried to start a 2nd claim for another member and the ability to change to that member was not available. I could not back out of that error without cancelling the application.

The concept is excellent as well as the interface. The only problem that I have experienced is having to resubmit lengthy claims and documents before receiving a technical message informing me that the Sun Life system is not available..service provider inscriptions, photos, etc all to waste. It would be good to know if the service is available before starting a claim submission process. Also, the photo submission of documents doesn't always work. I was refused for this reason even after doing.
